ideas.name: C1: Shallow depth_variable sweep
ideas.description: Fit TreeHFD with depth_variable set to several values (e.g. 2, 3, 4, 6, and None). Choose the value with the lowest residual MSE on a held-out split of the training data, then refit and predict with it. Shallower variable selection cuts runtime, and tuning it can lower residual error.

ideas.name: C2: Importance-screened interaction list
ideas.description: Fit a cheap first TreeHFD pass or use xgboost gain on feature pairs that co-occur on tree paths. Keep the top-k pairs and pass them as interaction_list. Refit with only those pairs. Fewer components speed the fit, and the residual can fall because the discarded pairs were noisy.

ideas.name: C3: Residual ridge recalibration
ideas.description: On training data, compute the model predictions and the TreeHFD components. Fit a non-negative ridge regression with an intercept of the predictions on the component columns. Apply the learned per-component scales to held-out components. Each component still depends only on its own variables. This corrects shrinkage bias, which matters most under correlation.
